svg.title: Four GB300 NVL72 racks in one leaf group of a four-plane rail-optimized InfiniBand fabric
svg.desc: Four GB300 NVL72 racks, each one NVLink domain. NIC k of every tray belongs to rail k. In plane 0, racks 0-3 link to leaves 0-3 in leaf group 0, one leaf per rail; racks 4-7 link to leaf group 1, shown collapsed. Every leaf connects to every spine. Planes 1-3 are the same as plane 0 and are shown only as a placeholder.
